FX-TURBNOISE-001.says: The settings as they start: basic, smooth, not inverted, contrast 100, brightness 0, size 100 at scale 100 by 100, offset 0, complexity 6, evolution 0, seed 0, opacity 100, normal. Grey clouds so large that the card sees a small part of one: close greys near the middle. Every pixel keeps its covering, the empty ones stay empty, and with nothing keyed frame 4 is frame 0: Turbulent Noise has no speed of its own.

FX-TURBNOISE-002.says: Size 4: a cell of 2.7 pixels (D-772), so the greys vary across the card.

FX-TURBNOISE-003.says: Size 4, fractal type turbulent: each octave's distance from the middle, so the clouds crease into dark veins.

FX-TURBNOISE-004.says: Size 4, noise type block: each cell of each octave one grey, square steps.

FX-TURBNOISE-006.says: Size 4, invert on: FX-TURBNOISE-002 turned over about the middle grey, light where it was dark.

FX-TURBNOISE-007.says: Size 4, complexity 1.9, which counts as 1: one octave, the smooth value noise itself.

FX-TURBNOISE-008.says: Size 4, complexity 20, the most: twenty octaves.

FX-TURBNOISE-009.says: Size 4, contrast 300: FX-TURBNOISE-002's greys three times as far from the middle, held at black and white.

FX-TURBNOISE-010.says: Size 4, brightness 30: FX-TURBNOISE-002 lifted by 0.3, held at white.

FX-TURBNOISE-011.says: Brightness -100: held at 0 everywhere, every shown pixel black.

FX-TURBNOISE-012.says: Size 4, evolution 360: one full turn moves the field one cell through its third direction, clouds of their own.

FX-TURBNOISE-013.says: Size 4, evolution keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 720 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-TURBNOISE-002 and frame 2, at 360, is FX-TURBNOISE-012.

FX-TURBNOISE-014.says: Size 4, seed 7: clouds of their own.

FX-TURBNOISE-015.says: Size 4, seed 7.9, which counts as 7: FX-TURBNOISE-014.

FX-TURBNOISE-016.says: Size 4, scale width 200 and scale height 50: clouds twice as wide and half as tall.

FX-TURBNOISE-017.says: Size 4, offset 2.5 right and 3 up: the clouds slide with it.

FX-TURBNOISE-018.says: Size 4, blend multiply: the card darkened by the clouds; the black patch stays black.

FX-TURBNOISE-019.says: Size 4, blend screen, opacity 50: the card lightened, none darkened.

FX-TURBNOISE-020.says: Size 4, blend add, opacity 50: added at half strength, not held, so the white patch goes past its covering.

FX-TURBNOISE-021.says: Size 4, opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 is the drawing; frame 2 is held at 100 and is frame 4, FX-TURBNOISE-002.

FX-TURBNOISE-022.says: FX-TURBNOISE-002 moved three pixels right: the clouds are worked in the drawing's own space, so they move with it.

FX-TURBNOISE-023.says: Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-024.says: Complexity 21, above 20. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-025.says: Contrast 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-026.says: Brightness keyed to -1200 at frame 4, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-027.says: Seed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-028.says: Scale width 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-029.says: Fractal type "plasma", which is not one of the seventeen. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-030.says: Noise type "cubic", which is not one of the five. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-031.says: Invert "yes", which is not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-032.says: Size 4, blend overlay: the card's light parts lightened and its dark parts darkened by the clouds, the black and white kept (the Timeline's Overlay, D-301, on the linear colour).
